# Abbreviations

<!-- source: https://publications.pages.asam.net/standards/ASAM_OpenDRIVE/ASAM_OpenDRIVE_Specification/v1.8.1/specification/04_abbreviations/04_abbreviations.html -->

## 4 Abbreviations

ASAM
:   Association for Standardization of Automation and Measuring Systems

CRG
:   Curved Regular Grid

ECU
:   Electronic Control Unit

PROJ
:   PROJ coordinate transformation software library

TM
:   Transverse Mercator

UML
:   Unified Modeling Language

XML
:   Extensible Markup Language
